content.text: {"core": "Source is the turn that brings the next thing in — the moment where what was outside arrives and the situation shifts on its own. In Discipline, it feeds arrivals into a steady solitary practice, the tending done alone and by hand. Unregistered, the incoming turn keeps working while the practice acts as if nothing new has come — fresh material lands and the same routine runs over it, so what arrived is handled without being taken in.", "sheetLine": "Something new keeps arriving, and the quiet practice runs on as though it hadn't."}
